property_summary: For every call to transfer(...), the reference contract always succeeds (does not revert) even when the _tos array is non-empty because it requires at least one recipient and will only attempt calls when length>0; the mutant that removes the require allows empty _tos which changes observable behavior when an adversarial callee would revert on attempted calls — specifically, the reference never makes any external calls when _tos is empty (so call succeeds), whereas the mutant makes zero calls too; to witness difference we instead rely on the rule: the reference always reverts if any callee low-level call in the loop fails because of the in-loop require(_s), while the mutant still reverts for failing callee calls but differs in that the reference disallows empty _tos inputs which the mutant allows — thus the invariant: for every input where _tos is empty, the reference reverts (due to require) but the mutant does not revert, so there exist inputs (empty _tos) where behaviors differ.
change_summary: Remove the require on _tos.length so empty _tos arrays are allowed, changing observable behavior when called with empty arrays.
